title: The Firm
author: John Grisham
summary: A brilliant young law graduate from a poor background joins a small Memphis firm that lavishes him with perks. He slowly realises that its clients and its partners are not what they appear, and he cannot walk away.
readIf: you want a very readable legal thriller about getting in over your head.
skipIf: you want fresh style or surprising characters, since this book is about plot momentum.

pairings.reason: Another quick Grisham conspiracy with a smart, lone protagonist on the run from powerful people.
A more literary and morally complicated legal thriller that digs deeper into guilt and marriage.
